publish.title: Publishing
publish.lede: Send the latest image to a web server at regular intervals.

toggle.label: Publish to the server
toggle.help: When it is on, sending goes on even with this page closed.
toggle.invalid: I cannot turn sending on: check the fields below and try again.
toggle.failed: I cannot change the switch. Try again in a moment.

state.label: Status
state.unavailable: I cannot read the status. I will retry shortly.

help.disabled: Nothing is sent. Turn the switch on to start.
help.idle: The next send starts when the interval is up.
help.backoff: The server did not answer. I will retry on my own later.
help.suspended: The server rejected the token. Check the token and the device ID, then save again.

errors.load: I cannot read the publishing settings. Check that the engine is running, then try again.

codes.auth: The server rejected the token. Check the token and the device ID, then save again.
codes.rejected: The server rejected the image. Check the device ID and try again.
codes.too_large: The image is too large for the server. Reduce the long edge or the JPEG quality.
codes.rate_limited: The server asks to slow down: too many requests. I will retry later.
codes.server_error: The server had an internal problem. I will retry later.
codes.network: I cannot reach the server. Check the connection and the URL.
codes.timeout: The server did not answer in time. I will retry later.
codes.bad_response: The server answered in an unexpected format. Check the server URL.
codes.invalid_settings: Some settings are not valid. Correct them and save again.
codes.unknown: Unknown error. The engine log has the details.

deviceId.label: Device ID
deviceId.help: The name the server uses for this camera, for example allsky-1.

token.label: Token
token.help: The token is secret: once saved it is never shown again.
token.removing: The token will be removed when you save.

profileName.label: Profile name
profileName.help: Optional. Helps tell profiles apart if you use more than one.

interval.label: Interval
interval.help: Seconds between one send and the next. Minimum 15.

longEdge.label: Long edge
longEdge.help: Largest size of the image sent, in pixels.

quality.label: JPEG quality
quality.help: Higher is sharper and heavier. Default 75.

extra.help: Only needed if the server asks for one more header.

value.label: Header value
value.help: Treated like the token: it is never shown.
value.removing: The value will be removed when you save.

codes.ok: Connection works. The server accepts the token and the device ID.
codes.auth: The server rejected the token. Check the token and the device ID.
codes.no_health_endpoint: The server answers, but it has no health page. Check the URL.
codes.network: I cannot reach the server. Check the connection and the URL.
codes.timeout: The server did not answer in time. Try again in a moment.
codes.server_error: The server had an internal problem. Try again later.
codes.invalid_settings: Some settings are not valid. Correct them and try again.
